equity_bridge.note: Interim balance sheet; flows are consolidated so NCI is charged here, once. Book is above a pro-rata 7% of the modelled EV, so this is the conservative side.

equity_bridge.item: PRC withholding tax on repatriation of net cash (5% treaty rate on 15,812.5)
equity_bridge.note: The cash sits mainly in PRC subsidiaries; distributing it to the listed parent/shareholders costs 5% (HK treaty) to 10% WHT. Ongoing dividend WHT is already inside the 40% cash tax rate; this is the charge on the STOCK of cash. 10% would be -1,581.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: base-case stabilisation rate (terminal 1.0%); H1 FY2026 revenue +2.3% YoY after FY2022-25 declines; HSBC (Aug-2025) 2.4% revenue CAGR 2025-28; equity CAGR is not usable as a growth proxy for a company whose earnings fell 72% while book value grew on retained cash
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5-yr CAGR +6.6% diverges from revenue -0.5% and EPS -23.9%: book value grew because the company retained part of a shrinking profit stream on a cash pile; it says nothing about forward growth. FCF CAGRs: FY2020->FY2025 owner FCF (reported - SBC - interest, PP&E-capex basis for comparability) 6,522.9 -> 917.9.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs on FY annual actuals: revenue FY2022 21,310.9 / FY2020 18,592.5 -> FY2025 18,112.6; EPS 0.55 / 0.82 -> 0.21; equity 23,986.0 / 17,747.1 -> 24,432.1; owner FCF FY2022 4,349.6 / FY2020 6,522.9 -> FY2025 917.9 (reported 4,760.3 / 6,970.7 -> 1,386.2). SBC-adjusted FCF fell faster than reported FCF only because interest income grew (337.6 -> 466.9) as the pile grew while the business shrank -- the opposite of the SBC-masking case; SBC itself went to zero.

scenario_narratives.base: Decline-to-stabilisation. Revenue flat-to-+2% nominal, operating EBITDA margin held at 21-22% (vs 22.3% FY2025, 30.4% FY2024, 43% FY2021), capex at 7.5% of revenue covering plants and the herd, cash tax 40%. Owner FCF ~RMB1.4-1.7bn a year (7-8% of revenue), roughly 70-80% of which is paid out. Value is split roughly half operations, half net cash.
scenario_narratives.bull: Policy-assisted birth recovery plus share retention and mix: revenue compounding 3-5% to ~RMB25bn by year 10 and EBITDA margin back to 26%. Requires three independent things to go right (births, competitive detente, premium mix), hence the below-default weight.
scenario_narratives.bear: Structural decline continues at 3-5% a year and competition takes the margin to 16%. Owner FCF shrinks toward RMB0.5bn but stays positive; the cash pile and NCI/WHT bridge dominate the per-share value.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Feihe is valued as a shrinking-to-stable cash cow plus a very large net-cash balance. The operating business is modelled from components with no recovery to historical peak margins; the cash pile (structured deposits, bank deposits, cash) is taken at face less a 5% repatriation withholding charge and the NCI, with its interest income stripped from the flows so nothing is counted twice. The result is a per-share value well above the HKEX price in every scenario, which says the market is applying a large discount to the balance sheet (and/or expects the decline to be steeper than the bear case) rather than that the operations are mispriced. A buyer is underwriting the conversion of mainland cash into dividends -- the FY2025 payout (HK$0.25/share, ~10% yield at the current price) is the evidence that conversion is happening.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cash-pile realisability: ~RMB8.3bn of 'structured deposits' are FVTPL wealth-management products whose underlyings include trust plans and insurance assets, not only bank deposits; a 20% haircut on them is ~RMB0.19/share (~HK$0.22). The model takes them at fair value.

Repatriation: cash is held in PRC subsidiaries; dividends out carry 5-10% WHT (5% modelled on the stock) and are subject to statutory reserve and capital-control constraints. The dividend has been paid in HKD every half since IPO, which is the counter-evidence.
Births: a further leg down in the newborn cohort (7.9m in 2025) takes the bear path from a 30% to a majority probability; the subsidy response is untested.
Competition/share: Yili and Danone share gains; the RMB1.2bn giveaway could become a permanent promotional floor, keeping EBITDA below the 21% base assumption.

Governance signals: chairman's holding restructured through trust entities (Sep-2025), a non-executive director resignation (May-2026) and heavy short-selling (Aug-2026) -- none quantified in the model.

Capex into a declining market: RMB1.17bn PP&E added in H1 FY2026 plus a RMB546m farm acquisition 'to expand production capacity'; if capex stays at 10-12% of revenue instead of normalising to 7.5%, base FCF falls ~RMB0.5bn a year.
FX: all values computed in CNY and converted at 1.1746; a 5% CNY depreciation against the pegged HKD reduces every HKD figure by 5%.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API, HKEX regular close at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range HK$2.40-4.48. FX: Yahoo CNYHKD=X at the date in inputs.fx_note.
data_sources.financials: 6186.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics and kpis (CNY millions); FY2025 Annual Report (P&L p.76, balance sheet p.77-78, cash flow p.80-81, notes 5, 6, 13); H1 FY2026 Interim Report (P&L p.31, balance sheet p.33-34, cash flow p.36-37, notes 4, 5, 9, 10, 17).
data_sources.qualitative: 6186.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-24): business model, competitive position, bull/bear cases, guidance (no quantitative company guidance; HSBC 2.4% revenue CAGR 2025-28 as the only external reference).

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY0 = trailing twelve months to 30 June 2026: H2 FY2025 (8,962.1) + H1 FY2026 (9,362.4). Chosen so the flows and the 30-Jun-2026 balance sheet share a date; FY2025 audited revenue was 18,112.6.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted weighted average for H1 FY2026 (interim note 9): 8,807.66m basic (9,067.25m in issue less 259.59m treasury shares held after the FY2025 buyback) + 9.64m dilutive awarded shares = 8,817.30m. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows (currently ~0) and no non-SBC issuance is in prospect.
inputs.net_cash_note: 30 June 2026 interim balance sheet. Cash-like: cash and cash equivalents 7,069.5 (includes 749.2 of >3-month time deposits) + structured deposits (wealth-management products, FVTPL, current) 8,294.3 + long-term bank deposits 990.0 = 16,353.8; restricted cash 32.5 excluded. Debt: bank borrowings 380.1 current + 40.0 non-current = 420.1; lease liabilities 28.3 + 92.9 = 121.2 (lease treatment A: in net debt, principal NOT deducted from flows). Net cash 15,812.5 ~ RMB1.79/share ~ HK$2.11/share, i.e. ~85% of the market price. Structured deposits turned over 7.5bn redemptions/6.5bn purchases in FY2025 and are treated as cash; their underlyings include money-market, interbank, bonds and also 'assets in insurance, trust fund plans and letters of credit' (AR FY2025 MD&A), so they are not all bank deposits -- see key_risks.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: TTM to Jun-2026, OCF less ALL investing capex: OCF 4,388.8 (H2 FY2025 2,136.3 + H1 FY2026 2,252.5) - PP&E/ROU purchases 1,300.2 - biological-asset additions 736.4 + biological-asset disposal proceeds 285.5 - raw-milk farm acquisition 517.0 (interim note 17, satisfied in cash 546.3) = 2,120.8. The core_metrics FreeCashFlow column (OCF - PP&E only) is 3,088.7 TTM and 1,386.2 FY2025; it omits the herd capex (~700m/yr) and the acquisition, which is why it is not used as the base.
inputs.interest_income_note: TTM interest RECEIVED (cash basis): FY2025 487.4 - H1 FY2025 190.8 + H1 FY2026 88.7 = 385.3. P&L interest income TTM 401.7. Stripped because the cash pile is added to EV in the bridge. Fair-value gains on structured deposits (TTM +76.4) are non-cash and already excluded from OCF.
inputs.sbc_source: AR FY2025 cash flow statement 'Equity-settled share-based expense' RMB1,431k (0.008% of revenue); H1 FY2026 interim: nil. FY2024 54.2m, FY2023 162.7m. EquityAwardTaxes nil in all years (no net-share settlement). SBC-zero: house and street bases coincide; the 9.6m dilutive awarded shares are inside the diluted count.
inputs.buyback_note: TTM: RMB1,020.7m repurchased in H2 FY2025 (259.6m shares now held in treasury); nil in H1 FY2026. Buybacks are value-neutral in this model (SBC ~0, count flat); recorded for the reader. Dividends TTM 1,882.6 (H2 FY2025 896.6 + H1 FY2026 986.1) exceed owner FCF and are funded from the cash pile.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1746, Yahoo CNYHKD=X regular close 2026-10-23T14:05Z (5-day range 1.1728-1.1751). Statements, flows and all per-share values are computed in RMB (CNY) and converted at this rate for the HKD quote. No dual listing exists for a parity check; cross-check: HKD peg 7.80/USD / 1.1746 implies USD/CNY 6.64, consistent with the spot rate. FY2025 dividends were declared in HKD (interim HK$0.1209 + final HK$0.1290 = HK$0.25/share) against RMB profits, so the company itself bridges at prevailing spot.
inputs.fy0_note: FY0 flows are the TTM to 30 June 2026, not calendar FY2026; projection year 1 is the twelve months to June 2027, labelled FY2027 by the engine. Valuation date is ~4 months into year 1 so end-of-year discounting is slightly conservative.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10-year China government bond ~1.8% + equity risk premium for a Hong Kong-listed mainland consumer name ~6.5% x beta ~1.0 = ~8.3% cost of equity; debt is 3% of capital at ~3.5% pre-tax so WACC rounds to 8.5%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: the demographic, competitive and cash-repatriation risks are carried in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked into the rate (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: A -- leases as debt. Lease liabilities (121.2 at 30-Jun-2026) sit in total_debt; lease principal (TTM ~37m) is NOT deducted from the flows; ROU depreciation (~39m/yr) stays inside D&A. Immaterial at 0.2% of revenue either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (NCI took 7.4% of FY2025 profit, 7.1% of H1 FY2026). Non-controlling interests deducted ONCE, in the equity bridge at 30-Jun-2026 book value (1,755.4). FY2025 tie: modelled operating NOPAT 2,981.6 x (1-0.40) = 1,789 + after-tax interest income ~350 - NCI 154 = ~1,985 vs reported attributable 1,939.
inputs.ebitda_definition: Operating EBITDA = profit before tax + finance costs + depreciation of PP&E/investment property/ROU + amortisation + change in fair value less costs to sell of biological assets (non-cash herd depletion, added back because herd additions are charged as capex) - interest income - fair-value gains on structured deposits (+ losses). Government grants (income-related 519m FY2025, 67m H1 FY2026) are left inside EBITDA; their collapse is already in the TTM margin. FY2024 6,297.6 (30.4%), FY2025 4,037.6 (22.3%), H1 FY2025 2,337.1 (25.5%), H2 FY2025 1,700.5 (19.0%), H1 FY2026 2,206.5 (23.6%), TTM 3,907.0 (21.3%). D&A line in the model = depreciation + amortisation + biological FV loss (FY2025 1,056.0 = 5.8%; H1 FY2026 896.3 = 9.6% after gross PP&E depreciation jumped 51% YoY on the new farms/plants). Capex line = PP&E/ROU purchases + biological additions + asset acquisitions - biological disposal proceeds (FY2025 1,337.5 = 7.4%; TTM 2,268.1 = 12.4% incl. the 517m acquisition; ex-acquisition 9.6%).
inputs.tax_note: Cash tax modelled at 40% of operating EBIT (bull 37%, bear 42%). Effective P&L rate has been 32% (FY2023), 34% (FY2024), 37.5% (FY2025), 38% (H1 FY2026): PRC 25% statutory plus 5-10% withholding tax on dividends upstreamed from PRC subsidiaries (the company pays out >100% of profit), non-deductible biological FV losses and overseas losses. TTM cash tax 1,216.6 / operating EBIT 2,730 = 45%; ~100m of that is tax on the interest income stripped above, so ~41% is attributable to operations.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon (margins are flat by year 5 but the bear decline and bull recovery play out over 6-8 years). Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US consumer' -> owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md (currency a1/a2, leases b, NCI c, matching-asset d, SBC-zero e, risk-once f). Business: China's largest domestic infant-formula producer (87.6% of revenue), vertically integrated into dairy farming; the category is in STRUCTURAL decline (0-3 cohort ~26.5m in 2025 vs 41.9m in 2020), so the scenarios are decline-to-stabilisation paths, not a mid-cycle recovery to the FY2021 peak (43% EBITDA margin). Net cash is ~85% of the market price: at HK$2.47 the market is paying ~RMB2.7bn EV for a business that generated ~RMB3.9bn TTM operating EBITDA, i.e. it discounts the cash pile heavily (PRC cash-trap, structured-deposit opacity, chairman's holding restructured through trusts, ~49% short-sale turnover days in Aug-2026). The model takes the pile at value less a 5% repatriation WHT and the NCI; the valuation is therefore a bet on that discount closing as much as on the operations. Price is the HKEX regular close, not an after-hours print. Working capital: inventories+receivables+prepayments (4,316) < payables+accruals (6,844), a negative-WC distributor model, so wc_capture is +10% of the revenue change (growth releases, decline absorbs cash). H1 FY2026 OCF included a 901m rise in other payables/accruals (unpaid promotional accruals) that will partly unwind.

bear.narrative: The H1 FY2026 uptick was the giveaway pulling demand forward; births resume falling after a one-year subsidy bump, Yili confirms the #1 position and the price war becomes permanent. Revenue declines 4-5% a year through 2030 then 2-3% (revenue ~RMB13.7bn by year 10, back to FY2019 level), EBITDA compresses to 16% as fixed farm costs deleverage, cash tax 42%. The business remains cash-generative (~4% FCF margin) on a shrinking base; terminal growth 0%, 10x cap. The balance sheet, not the operations, carries most of the value in this path.

base.narrative: Revenue stabilises: +2.5% in the year to Jun-2027 (H1 FY2026 +2.3%, soft H2 FY2025 comp), fading to 1% nominal as the birth cohort flattens under the RMB3,600/child subsidy and other-dairy growth (+36% FY2025, ~1% gross margin) offsets formula erosion. Operating EBITDA holds 21-22%: promotional intensity does not ease but the RMB1.2bn giveaway does not repeat at scale. Capex normalises from 8.5% (farm acquisition) to 7.5%, in line with a 7.5% D&A+herd-depletion charge. Cash tax 40%. Terminal 1% growth, 12x FCF cap (Gordon at 8.5%/1% is 13.5x, so the cap binds).

bull.narrative: Pro-natalist policy lifts births from 2026-28 off the 7.9m low, Feihe holds #1 share against Yili and Danone as the giveaway converts to retained users, super-premium mix and the children's/adult nutrition second curve lift gross margin back toward 66-68% while selling spend falls back to ~33% of revenue -- EBITDA recovers to 26% (still 4pp below FY2024, 17pp below FY2021). Revenue 4-5% for three years then 2-3%. Tax 37% as overseas losses narrow. Terminal 2%, 14x cap.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default: the revenue driver (China births) is a secular decline that management cannot influence, FY2025 formula revenue fell 16.8% with the company itself citing 'intensified competition', and third-party data suggest Yili has taken the #1 position. Bull cut to 20%: it needs births to respond to subsidies AND the price war to ease AND premium mix to recover, three independent conditions. Base 50%. The weights price the structural risk in the flows; the WACC is not raised for it.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
